worldcombat.skill.fierywrath.summary: Bursts wrath out of the body as a ring of aura centred on the user: foes inside take damage that falls off with distance, and a solid hit may leave them flinched and pushed slightly outward. You have to stand in the middle of them; the lingering style keeps burning those who stay, the pure burst hits harder once.
worldcombat.skill.fierywrath.use.1: Fluster and interrupt the foes crowding you
worldcombat.skill.fierywrath.use.3: Hurt worse as you get cornered
worldcombat.skill.fierywrath.description: The aura bursts outward to a %2$s block radius around the user, dealing about %1$s damage to each foe inside (heavier nearer the centre); the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
Foes on the rim still take at least %1$s of the burst; a hit knocks them about %2$s blocks outward.

A solid hit has a %1$s flinch chance: it applies a %2$s s flinch and tries to interrupt an interruptible action the target is already performing; while flinched the target can start no new moves and make no ordinary attacks.
Lingering: the aura lasts %2$s s, burning each foe inside for about %1$s more damage every %3$s s and pushing those who stay outward again.
worldcombat.skill.fierywrath.linger.on: Lingering on: the burst deals about 20%% less and pushes weaker, but the aura stays and keeps burning; 2 ticks more wind-up and 10 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.fierywrath.linger.off: Lingering off (pure burst): one heavier burst with no lingering, and 2 ticks less cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.fierywrath.timing: Cast on yourself; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast. The %1$s block aura radius is also the AI's standing distance.
worldcombat.skill.fierywrath.growth.0: At level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.fierywrath.growth.1: At level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s power, a %3$s block aura, and the flinch chance to %4$s.
On: the burst deals about 20%% less, but the aura stays and keeps burning those who do not leave, with 10 ticks more cooldown. Off: one heavier burst with no lingering and a shorter cooldown.
The companion will not push into the crowd beyond this distance and waits outside the aura's reach instead. Higher makes it willing to close in first.
With this on, the companion raises Fiery Wrath when another foe stands within 3.5 blocks of the target, catching a whole ring; off keeps the normal attack order.
